def main(self, function):
        """
        Decorator to define the main function of the experiment.

        The main function of an experiment is the default command that is being
        run when no command is specified, or when calling the run() method.

        Usually it is more convenient to use ``automain`` instead.
        """
        captured = self.command(function)
        self.default_command = captured.__name__
        return captured

class ConfigDict:
    def __init__(self, d):
        self._conf = normalize_or_die(d)

    def __call__(self, fixed=None, preset=None, fallback=None):
        result = dogmatize(fixed or {})
        recursive_fill_in(result, self._conf)
        recursive_fill_in(result, preset or {})
        added = result.revelation()
        config_summary = ConfigSummary(added, result.modified, result.typechanges)
        config_summary.update(undogmatize(result))
        return config_summary
